aesthetic: Highly futuristic, cinematic, glassmorphism, deep blacks, neon blue accents

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter text-white

layout.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use py-24 to py-32 for sections, gap-8 to gap-12 for grids.

hero.instructions: Place the H1 'Real-Time Autonomous AI Simulation' at the top center. Below the text, implement the ultra-wide iframe. Give the iframe wrapper an aspect-video ratio, max-w-7xl w-full, rounded-2xl overflow-hidden, and a border of border-[#00E5FF]/30 with a heavy box-shadow shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(0,229,255,0.15)].

tech_specs_card.classes: bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:border-[#00E5FF]/50 hover:bg-white/[0.04] transition-all duration-300 relative group overflow-hidden
tech_specs_card.hover_effect: Subtle translate-y-[-4px], border color shifts to neon blue.

video_card.classes: bg-[#0a0b10] border border-white/10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden group cursor-pointer hover:border-[#00E5FF]/40 transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,229,255,0.1)]
video_card.play_button: absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 backdrop-blur-sm

button.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-lg hover:border-white transition-colors duration-300

form_input.classes: bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00E5FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00E5FF] transition-all

visual_effects.glassmorphism: Always combine bg-white/[0.02] with backdrop-blur-xl and a 1px border-white/10. Do not use pure transparent backgrounds for cards or nav.
visual_effects.background_glow: Add a fixed background element or radial gradient to the body: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(0,85,255,0.1) 0%, #050505 60%). This prevents the black from feeling flat.
visual_effects.neon_accents: Use #00E5FF for text highlights, active borders, and subtle glowing shadows.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, forms, and cards MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'hero-iframe', 'tech-spec-card', 'video-item', 'contact-submit-button', 'cms-add-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. DEPENDENCIES: Install Google Fonts 'Unbounded' and 'Outfit' in index.html or global css. Install 'lucide-react' for tech and contact icons.
2. THEME ENFORCEMENT: Stick strictly to the dark/neon archetype. No white backgrounds, no soft pastel shadows. Ensure high contrast.
3. HERO SECTION: Embed the provided Eagle3D URL in an iframe. Make it massive and cinematic (w-full, aspect-video). Add a glowing neon border to its container.
4. TECH SPECS: Create a 3-column bento/grid layout. Use glassmorphism classes provided. Topics: 'Reinforcement Learning', 'Real-Time Raytracing', 'Spline Pathfinding'.

5. CMS FUNCTIONALITY (Admin + Video Grid): Create a simple FastAPI backend with SQLite (or memory) to store 'Training Logs'. The schema should include id, title, description, and thumbnail_url. Create a frontend Admin route/modal to add new entries, and a public 'Training Logs & Results' grid that fetches and displays them using the 'video_card' classes.
6. SEED DATA: Seed the database with at least 2 entries using the image URLs provided in the media section.
7. FOOTER: Build a minimalist glassmorphic contact form and include the user's specific links: LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/paras-singh-9b422129b/) and Email (parassinghme@gmail.com).
8. ACCESSIBILITY & TESTING: Ensure all interactive elements have hover/focus states and include `data-testid` attributes.
